title: Adding to a hurt
literal_meaning: Smear mustard paste on a cut wound.
explanation: The short phrase puts a deliberate action against an existing hurt. The dictionary glosses ଛାପ୍ୱା as smearing and repeats the expression with ମଡ଼ାଇବା. Our figurative reading hears an added injury: a taunt or needless reproach when someone is already upset. The wound is the image carrying that reading, not a treatment instruction.
meaning_odia: ଆଗରୁ କଟା ଘା ଅଛି, ତାହା ଉପରେ ପୁଣି ବେଶର ବୋଳାଯାଉଛି। ଅଭିଧାନ ଛାପ୍ୱାକୁ ବୋଳିବା ବା ମଡ଼ାଇବା ବୋଲି ବୁଝାଏ। ଆମ ରୂପକ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଆଗରୁ ଦୁଃଖିତ ଲୋକକୁ ଟାହି ବା ଅନାବଶ୍ୟକ ଭର୍ତ୍ସନାରେ ଆହୁରି କଷ୍ଟ ଦେବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଆସେ। ଏହି ଘାର ଚିତ୍ର କଥାର ଦଂଶନ ବୁଝାଏ, ଚିକିତ୍ସାର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ ଦିଏନାହିଁ।
english_summary: Our reading hears a further hurt added to one already felt.
odia_summary: ଆଗରୁ ଥିବା କଷ୍ଟକୁ ଆହୁରି ବଢ଼ାଇବାର ଚିତ୍ର।
usage_example: Original imagined example: A friend is disappointed after missing a deadline. When another person repeatedly jokes about the mistake, someone quotes this phrase and asks them to stop. The imagined use challenges the extra taunt without excusing the missed deadline.
cultural_context: The source labels this Sambalpuri. Lexical220334 supplies Odia ସୋରଷବଟା; its English “rye paste” is retained as a source discrepancy, not adopted. That source is lexical context only. Social application is editorial.
